gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-solway: Bruno Ace draws every line with a ruler's constancy, its characters spaced out one slow beat at a time. Solway follows in a text serif with a generous opening into the e, and a longer read stays bookish and authoritative.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-yuji-boku: Sharp, spaced and ruler-straight, Bruno Ace takes the lead with open counters. Yuji Boku follows in a dignified serif whose wide c looks like a bracelet pulled apart, giving the page an editorial turn.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-nunito-sans: Rule-straight and slow-paced, Bruno Ace holds one true monoline from start to finish. Nunito Sans takes over below in soft sans-serif curves with open mouths, so a longer passage goes down gently.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-dm-sans: Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters like beads on a thread, each stroke keeping one constant width. And DM Sans sits beneath in a friendly plain sans, its wide-set s terminals softening the stretched, expressive heading above.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-paquito: A round bowl outline that never swells or thins is the giveaway in Bruno Ace SC. Paquito sits close to it as a confident text serif, its caps barely taller than the lowercase, while the heading is best big and brief.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-aleo: Aleo reads dignified and classic, with counters the eye slips in and out of easily. Bruno Ace SC has no hairlines to squint at, so it holds up even at modest sizes, and a larger size for the heading would let its spaced letters show.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC is an authoritative text serif whose mouths stay open on c, e and a. And Bruno Ace SC matches that openness with strokes that never thin out, a distinctive heading with dignity beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-antic-slab: Antic Slab reads editorial and dignified, a text serif whose round bowls keep their walls constant all the way around. But Bruno Ace SC brings the expressive punch, its spread-out letters giving the pair a distinctive, memorable face.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-arvo: Arvo reads traditional and dignified, a serif whose curves refuse to close up. Bruno Ace SC, bent like a single length of wire, gives the page a spaced-out, expressive top line that Arvo grounds below it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-belgrano: Belgrano reads classic and traditional, a classic serif whose open-mouthed curves stay clear and easy to follow. Bruno Ace SC adds distinctive display character, with no weight shift anywhere along its curves.
